question: What is the height of the Allahabad pillar which bears inscriptions associated with Samudragupta?
solution:
The correct answer is __**35 feet**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Allahabad pillar is a significant historical artifact that stands **35 feet tall**.
 
• The pillar is renowned for bearing **inscriptions associated with Samudragupta**, an illustrious ruler of the Gupta Empire.
 
• These inscriptions provide valuable insights into the reign and achievements of **Samudragupta**.
 
• The pillar is made of polished sandstone and is an excellent example of **ancient Indian craftsmanship**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Samudragupta**

 
 
• Samudragupta was one of the most prominent rulers of the Gupta Empire in ancient India.
 
• He is often referred to as the "Napoleon of India" due to his military prowess and conquests.
 
• His reign is considered a golden age in Indian history, marked by significant cultural and political achievements.
 
• The Allahabad pillar inscriptions elaborate on his various military campaigns and victories.
 
 
 
• **Gupta Empire**
 
 
• The Gupta Empire was an ancient Indian empire that existed approximately from the mid-to-late 3rd century CE to 543 CE.
 
• It is known for its golden age of Indian culture, economy, and intellectual achievements.
 
• The period witnessed significant advancements in science, art, literature, and philosophy.
 
• The Gupta period is also known for its splendid architecture and sculptures.
 
 
 
• **Inscriptions**
 
 
• Inscriptions are writings engraved on hard surfaces like stone or metal, often serving as historical records.
 
• They can provide valuable information about ancient societies, including their rulers, administrative systems, and cultural practices.
 
• The inscriptions on the Allahabad pillar are written in a poetic form known as "Prashasti," which means eulogy.
 
• These inscriptions are crucial for understanding the history and achievements of the Gupta rulers.
 
 
 
• **Polished Sandstone**
 
 
• Polished sandstone is a type of sedimentary rock that has been smoothed and polished to achieve a fine finish.
 
• It was commonly used in ancient Indian architecture and sculpture for its durability and aesthetic appeal.
 
• The Allahabad pillar is an excellent example of the use of polished sandstone in ancient Indian craftsmanship.
